_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Failure Incident and Repair Data
summary: This DID is used to report information about failure incidents and repair actions the contractor has completed in a format that can be imported to US government database systems.
use_relationship:
This DID is used to report information about failure incidents and repair actions the contractor has completed in a format that can be imported to US government database systems. The data will be used to track parts usage, categorize failures, identify test failures, quantify instances of No Fault Found, link repaired items back to removal from the end item, and provide the U. S. Government with data for use in failure analyses.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverables resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor Failure Incident and Repair Data submission shall adhere to the following characteristics so that it can be imported into U.S. Government databases:

children.title: Formatted as a pipe delimited text file
Trimmed field values
children.content: No spaces at beginning or end of field values.

children.title: Inclusion of every field listed in this DID
children.content: If no data is available for field, leave null between pipe separators.

children.title: This contractor shall provide data to the government
children.content: That is extracted from the company's own maintenance system. The files shall include the fields, formats, and any data specifications listed in the table below.
